description: The uncategorized backlog, grouped by merchant: how many rows each merchant has, and what the user has already categorized other rows of the same merchant under. Ordered by the largest single-currency outflow, which is not printed. Start a "help me categorize" conversation here.

account_id.description: Restrict to one account. Ids come from `accounts` in `document_info`.

from.description: Inclusive start of the charge-date range, as YYYY-MM-DD.

include_amounts.description: Print what each merchant adds up to. Off by default: the backlog is already ordered by it, and naming a category needs the merchant rather than the sum. Ask for it only when the user wants the spending itself.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

search.description: Matched against the merchant as written, the normalized merchant, and the provider label.

to.description: Inclusive end of the charge-date range, as YYYY-MM-DD.

name: uncategorized_merchants
title: Uncategorized merchants
